description.value:
The Academy's signature Transformation Technique. You assume the appearance of a Small or Medium humanoid, animal, or object you have observed. The illusion fools sight and sound but breaks the instant you take damage or are touched in a way that contradicts the form (e.g., a knock that meets empty air where a shoulder should be).

You gain a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to pass as the impersonated subject and to Stealth checks to blend into a crowd while transformed. The transformation lasts up to 10 minutes or until you choose to drop it (free action).

Heightened (+2) Duration extends to 1 hour; you may also impersonate creatures one size category larger than your own.
